candidatePledges.paraphrase: Introduce a federal tax exemption or relief for tips earned by eligible workers.
candidatePledges.locator: Chapter 3; Make Trump Tax Cuts Permanent and No Tax on Tips
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Define whether pledge requires zero federal income tax, zero payroll tax, or a bounded income-tax deduction.
notes: The 2025 statute offers a capped income-tax deduction with eligibility restrictions, not literal exemption from every tax; do not score fully delivered without predefined criterion.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Make specified expiring 2017 tax-cut provisions permanent.
candidatePledges.locator: Chapter 3; Make Trump Tax Cuts Permanent and No Tax on Tips
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Atomize individual TCJA provisions and their effective dates.
notes: A reconciliation law has multiple tax provisions; provision-by-provision mapping and expiry tests required.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Raise the nationwide federal minimum wage to at least $15 an hour.
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Nationwide statutory wage floor of at least $15; do not conflate with contractor wage.
notes: Do not carry over the 2020 outcome; 2024 cohort and governing control differ.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Provide universal free preschool for four-year-old children.
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Eligibility and financing for universal no-fee four-year-old preschool nationwide.
notes: Federal-state delivery and appropriations require separate review.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Establish a publicly owned Great British Energy company.
candidatePledges.locator: Manifesto; clean power / Great British Energy
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Statutory authority, corporate designation, operational status and capital deployment separately.
notes: Royal Assent alone is not evidence of operating scale, delivered projects or bill reductions.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Legislate new employment protections for workers.
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Atomize guaranteed hours, dismissal protection and other commitments, then verify commencement.
notes: Act contains staged commencements; enacted is not identical to in force.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Enable construction of 1.5 million homes over the parliament.
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Count net additional completed dwellings over pre-specified parliamentary period.
notes: Planning reforms and approvals are intermediate, not completed homes.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Establish Build Canada Homes to expand affordable housing construction.
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Separate institutional launch, appropriated funding, cash disbursement and completed homes.
notes: Budget proposal and government announcement are not completed dwellings or actual expenditures.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Balance federal operating expenditure and operating revenues by 2028.
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Define operating-balance accounting and fiscal-year boundary before judging.
notes: Capital/operating split and revised accounting definitions may alter comparison; budget projections are not actuals.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Allow eligible people working beyond retirement age to earn up to EUR 2,000 per month tax-free.
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Verify precise eligibility, income-tax provision, effective date and take-up.
notes: CDU programme is pre-election; coalition agreement is post-election and must be separate.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Reduce personal income taxation by EUR 2 billion, including EUR 500 million in 2025.
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Verify fiscal baseline, law, distribution, cash impact and nominal-year allocation.
notes: Party launch claim must be reconciled to full official programme and enacted annual budget.

candidatePledges.paraphrase: Gradually reduce general corporate income tax rate to 17%, and SME rate to 15%, during the legislature.
candidatePledges.successCriterion: Verify statutory general and SME rates, tax base, staged effective dates and deadline.
notes: Separate headline rates from actual effective tax paid.

licensing: Store original URLs and short original paraphrases only. Do not copy full party manifesto texts, republish PDF, or infer permission from public access.
reviewProtocol: Two independent coders must confirm source passage, pre-election publication, atomic eligibility, duplicate resolution, original intent-free success criterion, event linkage, competing explanations, in-force vs enacted vs paid and term-end/censoring. No independent review completed for these candidates.
caveats: This is a hand-picked expansion for source verification and is not an exhaustive sample.
Some 2024/2025 governing terms are not complete; right-censor outcomes.
The 2024 Democratic platform retains Biden-specific language despite candidate transition; party/candidate must not be conflated.
Do not mix budget proposals, appropriations, obligations, payments, or completed outputs.
Do not treat 2020 statutes as pledge matches until source and scope are independently established.
